source.warning: Postcode records come from a third-party repackage of ONSPD whose provenance has not been verified. Rebuild from the official ONSPD release before relying on this data.

boundaries.description: Boundaries are approximations derived from postcode reference points: each postcode is given the land closer to its reference point than to any other, and those cells are merged into sectors, districts and areas, then clipped to the coastline. Small detached groups of outlying points (up to 3) are drawn as part of the shape around them. They are not official Royal Mail or Ordnance Survey boundaries.

coverage.note: Northern Ireland (BT) postcodes are excluded from the map because their reuse terms differ (see docs). Search still resolves them via postcodes.io.
